title: Connection inspection and consent
responsibility: Ask before looking, and record what was granted. Obtain explicit permission before reading Pi's user authentication store, its custom-model registry, or the presence of any credential environment variable; then report sanitised availability only — provider display names, model identifiers, and present-or-absent for the research credential — contacting no external service. Persist the operator's grant where a clone does not carry it to another machine, and reopen the prompt when the provider or research choice changes.
notes: ⚠️ THE PROMPT'S WORDING IS PART OF THE COMPONENT. 'Check this computer for existing AI-provider and web-research connections' is what is happening; 'search for credentials' describes the same act in a way that is both more alarming and less accurate, since nothing is displayed or copied. ⚠️ A DECLINED INSPECTION PERFORMS NO READS AT ALL — not a presence check, not a registry load — and leaves setup honestly partial rather than reporting that nothing is configured.
